CustomObject.description: The wording of each letter staff can generate with Generate Letter. An admin edits the heading and body here, in Setup, Custom Metadata Types. The body takes merge fields in double braces: {{Name}}, {{Date}}, {{ApplicationNumber}}, {{MissingItems}}, {{BalanceDue}} and {{Details}} (what staff type when they generate the letter). A blank line starts a new paragraph.
CustomObject.label: Letter Template
